request_failure_observation.basis: The soak process was still alive and requests were continuously accepted when it was protectively stopped.
request_failure_observation.limitation: The forced safety stop prevented the script from persisting its final request counter, so an exact request-success count is unavailable.

runner_rss_mib.basis: Live process observation before the stop.
runner_rss_mib.precision_and_limit: A lower bound only; no retained raw soak samples permit independent recomputation of the decimal value.

free_system_ram_gib.basis: Live system-memory observation before the stop.
free_system_ram_gib.precision_and_limit: An upper bound only; no retained raw soak samples permit independent recomputation.

controller_followup_observation.basis: Controller observation after the initial lower-bound observation and before the protective stop.

stop_reason: Protective abort for genuine runner RSS growth/memory pressure before OOM could affect user processes; no retry was run.
evidence_limitations: The original soak sampler output was not persisted because the test process and its sampler were force-stopped for system safety.
This summary records contemporaneous observations and bounds; it does not claim an independently recomputable soak peak or exact request count.
The retained fixed-prompt probe is a distinct short measurement and must not be treated as soak telemetry.

retained_source_files.relevance: Retained three-prompt fixed resource probe preceding the soak; not raw soak telemetry.
